title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc.
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where magical girl is a profession that exterminates monsters called kaii, struggling job-hunter Kana Sakuragi uses her excellent memory to help magical girl Hitomi Koshigaya and is hired by the small startup Magilumiere. The series treats magic as engineering and business, with rival firms, a government agency and industry politics.
life_message: Diligent, careful work and good teammates give ordinary people a meaningful place in the world.

content.note: Monster-extermination action (AniList Kaiju, Superhero); MU has one vote for Character Death.
Kaii attacks such as one crashing a job interview; comedic tone (Wikipedia, AniList).
President Shigemoto dresses as a magical girl at work, played as comedy (Wikipedia; AniList Crossdressing); no romance reported.
Kana's repeated job-hunting rejections and self-doubt (Viz blurb).
Startup company life, business competition and industry politics are core (MU Business Competition, Capitalism; AniList Politics).

dominant: Workplace competence; teamwork; magic as industry; light business satire

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Disputes handled through companies, agencies and councils, not personal vendettas.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Regulated industry with a government magic agency and a council of organizations.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Coworkers and clients, not family, are the focus; Hitomi's estranged father is a subplot.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Small startup with a crossdressing president; rank exists but is light.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Magic is engineered with software and data, a secular-rational treatment.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: A jobseeker finds fulfilling work and identity.

folkways.japan: Draws on Japanese job-hunting culture (shūkatsu), startup and corporate norms, and magical girl genre conventions.

delivery.evidence: No source discusses delivery; reviewers praise comedy and satire of the genre (Wikipedia reception) (to verify).
delivery.note: Workplace themes appear to be carried by plot and comedy; no review calls it preachy.

winners_losers: Kana and the small Magilumiere team win respect through competence; sympathy goes to diligent workers over bigger, colder firms (to verify).
